args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE NEW KFB game character sheet, landscape 1536x1024 target, transparent PNG, EXACTLY SIX large complete characters arranged THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Use both supplied images as STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets: reference 1 defines rounded dark ink body, soft sculpted plasticine, modeled lids and handmade material; reference 2 defines high quality clay accessory modeling. Do NOT copy costumes, wings, repetitive face template or red eyeballs from references. Entirely new characters.

Subject: six distinct imaginary ink-blob warrior characters with a playful old Western / Native American-inspired costume vocabulary, surreal absurd cartoon claymation. These are members of the existing diverse fictional monster family wearing Western archetype costumes, not realistic portraits or a depiction of any actual people or named nation. Use inventive crafted feather arrangements, leather, turquoise accents, wood and rounded stone/metal weapon props. Personality-driven absurdity rather than caricatured human facial features. No text, no labels, no real tribal symbols.

STRICT anatomy/style: each is one WHOLE upright footless charcoal-black ink splat with subtle dark violet sheen, big continuous rounded body, thick irregular goo lobes, a few contained detached droplets. Face in body, tiny rounded goo hands as needed. No human torso, legs, feet, realistic skin, limbs hidden by full clothes, spiky fur or angular rocks. Limited accessories keep blob body dominant. Rich soft plasticine, delicate fingerprints and modeled seams, smoothly rounded volumes, controlled selective wear. Odd offbeat handmade cartoon acting, not polished Pixar humans or cute smiling mascots.

EYES FOR ALL SIX: conspicuous WHITE/IVORY EYEBALLS, small distinct RED IRIS, BLACK PUPIL. Thick fully violet-black clay eyelids. No all-red sclera. Mouths irregular cream teeth where visible, NEVER six identical toothy grins. No dangling tongues.

Cell choreography, all front-facing/very slight three quarter, upright with distinct emotions at their peak:
TOP LEFT: wide pear-shaped male-read elder commander. Compact fan of ivory feathers with dark tips curving around back of head, turquoise headband. He tries to look serenely authoritative, heavily lowered lids, one eyebrow high, firm compressed crooked mouth with one tooth peeking. Round ochre leather shield held against lower side, one ridiculous small arrow visibly stuck harmlessly in his own shield. Strong quiet skeptical acting, no open smile.
TOP MIDDLE: female-read tall teardrop archer with two long asymmetrically tilted rust-and-cream feathers and short dark clay side braids, turquoise band. Razor-focused sidelong aim, one eye narrowed, confident asymmetric toothy half-smirk. Holds a simple thick wooden bow vertically beside body, one comically blunt chunky arrow in the other hand. Bowstring visibly joins both bow tips. No drawn aiming pose extending into adjacent cell.
TOP RIGHT: round jittery male-read sentry, three short feathers sticking up in uneven directions, small stitched ochre scarf. Huge white eyes glancing sharply sideways, eyebrows lifted in startled indignation, clenched uneven teeth. Both hands clutch one short stout spear upright; spear tip looks almost too large for the anxious owner. Complete body stays upright and substantial.
BOTTOM LEFT: squat broad male-read warrior drummer, short sweeping sideways feather crest, simple red sash. Wild delighted battle enthusiasm, eyes squeezed into expressive white crescents with visible red iris/black pupils, broad asymmetrical cackling mouth with few irregular teeth. One small round leather drum strapped directly to lower blob and two chunky beaters raised within his own cell. Rhythmic body lean, upright; strong funny face.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: female-read compact angular-in-attitude but physically soft thick lobed blob, two swept-back ivory feathers in beaded turquoise headband. Utterly unimpressed, one large half-lidded eye and one raised skeptical lid, pursed lopsided lip, a single projecting ivory tooth. One broad stone-headed tomahawk held safely low across body, free goo hand resting on its blunt head like she is waiting for everyone else to finish. No nose or human anatomy.
BOTTOM RIGHT: tall top-heavy male-read grizzled frontier veteran, one worn drooping feather and short split fan behind head, faded leather shoulder strap. Ferocious outraged shout, irregular narrow open mouth with unequal teeth, heavily asymmetric brows, prominent white sclera. Holds a short thick old flintlock-style musket upright at his side, simple wooden stock and single steel barrel, no modern weapon parts, no smoke. The drooping feather comically contradicts his explosive temper.

COMPOSITION crucial: six equal 512x512 logical cells. Similar BODY HEIGHT in all six, about 300-330px excluding feather/weapon height, individual complete silhouettes occupy about 420-450px height. Do not make final row smaller. Eyes/props large enough for gameplay. Generous clear transparent gutters 24px or more between any silhouettes and between rows; keep all feathers, weapons, droplets fully within each cell. Do not overlap or touch neighbors. No frames/gridlines/row labels. No scene, floor, ground, background gradient, shadow disc, checkerboard, halo or floating punctuation. Soft upper-left studio lighting baked only into characters. Actual alpha transparency with fully opaque character interiors, clean antialiased edge.
